title: config.rs validate() uses UFCS zeroize::Zeroize::zeroize instead of method syntax
description: smtp/config.rs and reader/config.rs validate() call zeroize::Zeroize::zeroize(&mut seed_bytes) using UFCS (fully-qualified syntax). Other callers in the same codebase (smtp/main.rs line 201, reader/server_stores.rs line 389) use 'use zeroize::Zeroize as _;' followed by seed.zeroize() — the idiomatic method-syntax form. The UFCS works correctly but is inconsistent with the rest of the codebase and reads as though the author was uncertain whether the trait was in scope. Fix: add 'use zeroize::Zeroize as _;' at the top of the validate() block and call .zeroize() directly.
